topic: MCST Maintenance Fees & Share Value Schedule
content:
Lentor Modern Maintenance Fund Contributions & Share Value Breakdown:
• Rate per Share Value (SV): Sub-MC (Residential) is $39.00/SV/month; Main MC (Common Property) is $5.80/SV/month. Total base rate is $44.80/SV/month (excl GST) or $48.832/SV/month (incl 9% GST).
• 1-Bedroom + Flex (527 sf): 8 SV = $358.40/month ($390.66 incl GST) | 6-month advance: $2,343.94
• 2-Bedroom + Flex (678 & 732 sf): 9 SV = $403.20/month ($439.49 incl GST) | 6-month advance: $2,636.93
• 3-Bedroom + Flex Compact (969-990 sf): 10 SV = $448.00/month ($488.32 incl GST) | 6-month advance: $2,929.92
• 3-Bedroom + Flex Premium (1109-1130 sf): 11 SV = $492.80/month ($537.15 incl GST) | 6-month advance: $3,222.91
• 4-Bedroom + Flex (1528 sf): 11 SV = $492.80/month ($537.15 incl GST) | 6-month advance: $3,222.91
First 6 months are collected upon TOP. Subsequent bills are issued by Managing Agent CBRE (managementoffice@LT-MODERN.COM, +65 6054 3370). Refuse disposal (CORA Environment) is billed separately by SP Services.

Official defect reporting at Lentor Modern is conducted via the Novade Quality mobile app. Step 1: Log in with credentials provided during key collection. Step 2: Tap 'Lodge a Defect', select your unit, unit location (e.g. Master Bedroom, Living Room), and defect element (e.g. Tiles, Painting, Joinery). Step 3: Attach clear photos with close-up and wide perspective. Step 4: Submit ticket. Status will progress: 'Pending Contractor' -> 'Under Rectification' -> 'Ready for Joint Inspection'. Joint inspection must be signed off on the app once repairs are satisfied.

Defect Liability Period (DLP) for Lentor Modern:
• Individual Unit DLP: Strictly 12 months from each purchaser's individual Key Collection / Notice of Vacant Possession (NVP) date under the BCA Standard Sale & Purchase Agreement. Because unit handovers occur in staggered batches, each unit's DLP ends on a different date. Homeowners must check their exact expiry date directly inside the Novade Quality app or confirm with their assigned Block Manager / Customer Service Officer (CSO).
• Development & Common Property DLP: Ends on 25 February 2027 (confirmed by CBRE Management Office). This covers common property defects such as external wall façade, corridors, swimming pools, clubhouse, landscape deck, and lifts.
• Developer Obligation: The developer (GuocoLand) and main contractor (Lian Beng Construction) are legally required to rectify defects in materials and workmanship at their cost within 30 days of notification.
• How to Report: Log private unit defects via the Novade app. Report common property defects promptly to the Management Office (CBRE at managementoffice@LT-MODERN.COM or +65 6054 3370) so they can be documented and rectified before 25 February 2027.

Bedroom flooring at Lentor Modern is engineered timber. Maintenance rules: 1. NEVER wet mop with standing water (causes warping or buckling). Use a damp microfiber cloth with neutral PH timber cleaner. 2. Keep balcony sliding doors closed during heavy rain to prevent water ingress. 3. Apply felt pads under furniture legs (bed frames, chairs, tables) to prevent deep scratches. 4. Avoid dragging heavy luggage or furniture.

Renovation working hours: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM. STRICTLY NO noisy work (drilling, hacking, demolition) on Sundays and Public Holidays. Deposit: S$1,000 for non-hacking, S$2,000 for hacking works (refundable upon completion). Lift padding must be booked with the estate office at least 3 days prior to moving bulky items to protect lift finishes (failure incurs S$300 penalty).

Residential delivery loading bays are accessed via the dedicated residential ramp along Lentor Central (separate from the commercial Lentor Modern Mall loading dock). Height limit: 3.8 metres for the residential loading area. Heavy vehicles exceeding 4.2m must coordinate with security. Delivery riders can access towers via the B1 / Level 1 residential lobbies with intercom buzzer clearance from residents.

The official white paint specified and used by the developer for all interior walls and ceilings at Lentor Modern is Intermatt BS E55 (White). If engaging painters for touch-ups, defect rectification, or renovation repainting, request 'Intermatt BS E55' to ensure an identical sheen and color match with the developer's original handover coat.

The official paint specification for Lentor Modern balcony walls and exterior façade is: Brand: Dulux (ICI)
Colour Name: Thick Smoke
Colour Code: 96YR 09/033 (Composilicon W55)
Under MCST building façade by-laws, any touch-ups, wall repairs, or repainting on balconies must strictly match Dulux Thick Smoke (96YR 09/033) to preserve the uniform architectural aesthetic of the development.

topic: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Stations & Carpark Locations
content:
Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Facilities at Lentor Modern:
1. Residential Carpark (Level 3 under Block 3 / Tower 3):
• Exclusivity: Strictly for Lentor Modern residents (accessed via the resident barrier ramp using access card / registered vehicle IU).
• Number of Lots: 5 dedicated EV charging lots.
• Operator: Novowatt Pte Ltd (Mobile app: 'Watt - EV Charging' at watt.sg | 24/7 Support Hotline: +65 6537 7333).
• Rate: ~$0.50 per kWh (pay-per-use, no subscription fee required at Lentor Modern). Free parking for registered resident season vehicles.

2. Lentor Modern Mall Carpark (Basement 1, Lots 39 to 42):
• Access: Open to both residents and the public.
• Number of Lots: 4 AC charging lots.
• Operator: SP Mobility / SP Group (Billed via the SP app).
• Rate: ~$0.75 – $0.81 per kWh (subject to prevailing SP Group EV tariffs).
• Carpark Parking Fees: Standard mall carpark parking rates apply while charging ($1.20 for 1st hour, $0.50/30 mins thereafter; 10-minute free grace period).

💡 Resident Recommendation: Charging at Level 3 Resident Carpark via Novowatt (~$0.50/kWh, zero parking fees) is significantly more economical than the mall carpark. However, Basement 1 SP Mobility chargers are readily available as a backup.

topic: Facilities Operating Hours & Booking Guidelines (Level 4 & Level 14)
content:
Lentor Modern Recreational Facilities Operating Hours & Rules:
• Indoor Gymnasium (Level 4 Clubhouse): 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily (extended by Management / Concierge from initial 8:00 AM opening for early morning workouts). Note: Access is automated via Resident Access Card; the door will not unlock before 6:00 AM or after 10:00 PM, and lights/aircon shut off automatically at 10:00 PM sharp. Equipped with free weights/dumbbells up to 40kg, treadmills, lockers, towels, and water dispenser.
• Swimming Pool & 50m Lap Pool (Level 4): 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily. Proper swimming attire required; no footwear in pool perimeter.
• Tennis Court (Level 4): 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily. Bookable via iPlus Living app.
• Games Room & Dance Studio (Level 4 Clubhouse): Operating hours end at 10:00 PM daily. Located right next to the Dance Studio. Equipped with an electronic dart board and a multi-function convertible game table that serves as both a Pool / Billiard Table and a Table Tennis (Ping Pong) table. Bookable via the iPlus Living app.
• Dance Studio (Level 4 Clubhouse): Mirror-walled studio for dance, yoga, and aerobics (can be amalgamated with the Games Room for larger gatherings).
• Clubhouse Function Room (Level 4): Operating hours end at 10:00 PM. Features dining area, lounge, and kitchenette. Bookable via iPlus Living app.
• Sky Dining & BBQ Pavilions (Level 14 across Towers 3, 5, 7): Operating hours end at 10:00 PM daily. Bookable via iPlus Living app (subject to booking deposit and quotas).
• Resident Car Washing Bays (Level 3): Located at Carpark Lots 245, 259, and 292. Collect the water tap key from the Level 4 Concierge Desk.

topic: iPlus Living Mobile App Onboarding & Smart Intercom Registration
content:
iPlus Living App Onboarding & Mobile Intercom Setup:
1. Download: Search 'iPlus Living' on Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
2. Account Activation: Open the app, select 'Register / Sign Up', and enter your registered resident email address and Property Activation Code (provided in your official Handover / Welcome Pack from CBRE).
3. Smart Intercom / Buzzer Setup: Link your mobile phone number under 'Intercom / Visitor Access'. When visitors, couriers, or food delivery riders dial your unit from the basement or Level 1 entrance intercom panels, your phone will ring via video call on iPlus Living. You can view the visitor and tap 'Unlock' to release the pedestrian lobby door and grant elevator floor access remotely.
4. Household Members & Tenants: Primary owners can invite family members and registered tenants under 'Unit Management' to grant them digital access and app features.
5. Managing Agent Support: If you do not have your activation code or your unit is not linking, email managementoffice@LT-MODERN.COM or visit the Level 3 Management Office (+65 6054 3370).

topic: iPlus Living Facility Booking Policies & Deposit Guidelines
content:
iPlus Living Facility Booking Policies & Regulations:
• Bookable Facilities: Tennis Court (Level 4), Games Room (Level 4, with Darts & convertible Pool/Table Tennis table), Dance Studio (Level 4), Clubhouse Function Room (Level 4), Sky Dining Pavilions (Level 14 across Towers 3, 5, 7), and BBQ Pavilions (Level 14).
• Advance Booking Window: Bookings open 14 to 30 days in advance via the iPlus Living app on a first-come, first-served basis.
• Booking Quota: To ensure fair access for all 605 households, each unit is entitled to 1 peak session per week (Friday evenings, Saturdays, Sundays, and Public Holidays).
• Security Deposits: A refundable security deposit ($100 – $200 depending on facility) is charged via the app or payable to the MCST to cover any damages or excess cleaning. Deposits are refunded within 7–14 working days after post-event inspection.
• Cancellation Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours before the reserved timeslot via iPlus Living to receive a full refund of deposit. Late cancellations or no-shows forfeit the deposit.
• Non-Bookable Facilities: Indoor Gymnasium (6:00 AM – 10:00 PM) and Swimming Pools (7:00 AM – 10:00 PM) are open access for residents via Resident Access Card and do not require prior booking.

Smoking Restrictions & High-Rise Littering Regulations:
• Common Areas Smoking Prohibition: Under Singapore's Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Act administered by the National Environment Agency (NEA), smoking is strictly prohibited across all estate common property, including corridors, lift lobbies, staircases, recreational sky decks, swimming pool perimeters, gymnasium, and BBQ pavilions.
• High-Rise Littering (Cigarette Ash & Butts): Discarding cigarette butts, ash, or any items out of unit windows, balconies, or service yards is strictly illegal under the Environmental Public Health Act (EPHA) and estate by-laws. Under NEA legislation, a statutory presumption applies to the registered flat owner/occupier if litter originates from their unit. First-time court offenders face fines up to $2,000, subsequent offences up to $4,000 or $10,000, alongside Corrective Work Orders (CWO). Furthermore, burning butts create severe fire hazards.
• Reporting: Residents witnessing high-rise littering should note the tower, approximate floor/unit, date, and time, and report to the Management Office (CBRE at managementoffice@LT-MODERN.COM / +65 6054 3370 / Concierge +65 6054 3375) or file a report with photo/video evidence via the NEA myENV app.

topic: Minor DIY Works, Wall Drilling vs Formal Renovation Permit
content:
Minor DIY Works & Wall Drilling Guidelines:
• Minor Drilling & Fixtures: Minor interior DIY works such as drilling a few holes to mount art frames, mirrors, television brackets, or bathroom hooks typically do not require a full formal Renovation Permit (Form 2.0) or the $1,000/$2,000 renovation deposit, provided works are confined inside the unit and do not alter electrical distribution, plumbing risers, or structural elements.
• Strict Noisy Work Hours: Any drilling, knocking, or impact noise must strictly comply with estate by-law hours: Mondays to Fridays: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturdays: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM. Drilling is STRICTLY PROHIBITED on Sundays and Public Holidays.
• Structural & Service Precautions: Residents must exercise caution to avoid concealed electrical conduits, aircon refrigerant pipes, and concealed water pipes embedded within partition and masonry walls. For major contractor renovations, hacking, or carpentry fabrication, submission of Form 2.0 with the Managing Agent (CBRE) and a refundable deposit remain compulsory.
